title: FadoDB action call
description: What an action is called with (ADR-0045, item 4). A Go function registered for the action receives it as a value. A call may arrive more than once, after a crash or a failure of the store between the action's effect and its mark, each time with the same key: the receiver makes twice once by the key.

key.description: The key of the queued action, the same at every attempt: the id of the event that fired the rule, a colon, and the position of the action among those the event queued. The key of a trial starts with try: and names no event.

attempt.description: The count of the calls of this action, from 1.

action.description: The action, as its definition names it.

args.description: The arguments as the commit evaluated them, one for each parameter of the definition by its declared name, a parameter not given as null. Each is in the shape of a document's values: a bool, a number, text for an exact value, a money, a date and a ref, integer seconds for a datetime, any JSON for a json parameter.

event.description: The event that fired the rule. Absent in a trial, which belongs to no document.
